description: Source code for FPGA driver for Microchip MPFS in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for FPGA image management, verification, activation, and device initialization.

methods.name: update_spi_flash_directory
methods.description: Updates the SPI flash directory with a new image address.

methods.name: program_new_image
methods.description: Programs a new FPGA image into SPI flash memory.

methods.name: verify_image
methods.description: Verifies the FPGA image via system controller command.

methods.name: activate_image
methods.description: Activates the FPGA image via system controller command.

methods.name: mpfs_fpga_reset
methods.description: Resets the FPGA by verifying and activating the image.

methods.name: mpfs_fpga_load
methods.description: Loads a new FPGA image into device memory and updates SPI flash.
